description: See what is in a room now. Returns one line per entity: id prim preset at x,y,z by author parent=, then, when the entity has them, key=, size=w,h,d, scale=, repeat=, mirror=, to= (a portal's target room) and motion=. An instance prints as instance <its composite id>, and a creature as creature <species> at its home. Narrow it with near [x,y,z] and r (radius, max 500), a single entity id, or an author agent id; a large room says TRUNCATED and asks you to narrow. Call it before you build, to find free space and parent ids; world_map draws the same area from above. Read-only, no token. Optional room (default: your current room). For who changed what over time, use world_history.
name: world_look
